newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures hold firmer, off peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures hold firmer, off peaks.

text.p: Sept 25 - U.S. debt futures held small gains, off peaks. In Eurodollars, traders said one dealer had bought up to 29,000 combined in Dec, March and June, with talk of more buying to come. They said good buying from a couple houses lifted Dec T-bonds, which neared double-top at 109-00. Aug US existing home sales dipped to 4.13 million units but had scant impact. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
